title: Medical images reach physician cards only as validated design-system derivatives

problem.user_segment: physicians across the six launch specialties
problem.job: read a feed whose medical pictures are relevant to the article and drawn in one visual system
problem.observed_failure: The style layer for medical images was never connected: cardiology cards render licensed source crops directly (approved-medical-media.ts: 'no relabelling, no redraw'), catalog cards turn item.asset.url into card media, the Clinical Visual Recraft pipeline runs only from the editorial admin page, is hard-coded to cardiology, has no model keys in any environment and stores nothing. Other specialties have no source images at all.
evidence: server/portal/for-you.ts mediaFor: cardiology → { kind: 'image', src: asset.src } from public/media/cardiology
server/recraft/pipeline.ts: specialty !== 'cardiology' → unavailable; called only from app/api/media/recraft (editorial role)
git log --all -S runRecraft: only e625c91; no feed code ever called it
Vercel env: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY; data/article-motion-render-manifest.json has 0 entries

hypothesis: If every card picture is a deterministic, validated derivative of a matched source image (or in-house art, or nothing) with provenance to its source and document, physicians see relevant pictures in one visual system without stock aesthetics, invented clinical detail or cross-specialty leakage.
kill_criteria: a source image or a rejected transformation is rendered on a physician-facing card
a derivative changes side, position or count of a clinical structure relative to its source
a derivative shows text that differs from the source or an English label on the Russian surface
a card shows a derivative of another clinical object or another specialty
a derivative is published without source, document, pipeline version and validation record
